title: near-tear-gear: rpg-edit opens every pets-like game

glossary.S: about one focused session including harness and mutation tests (my estimate)
glossary.L: several sessions or needs a design first

preconditions.title: One shared core under all 11 games, and every edit verb (place, remove, newroom, newpal, delpal, save, load, goto, control) is in it
preconditions.evidence: RAN today: all 9 verb names found in petslike_core.c; the built rpg-space and rpg-dust binaries contain newroom / newpal / place

preconditions.title: The window layout (toolbar tabs, rail, left/right bars, hotbar) is a data template, and 7 of 11 are identical once the game name is swapped
preconditions.evidence: RAN today: diff of board/pchq-board.xhtpm vs cdda-hq = 0 lines for civ-rpgce, df-hq, dsr-rpg, gta-hq, mcl-hq, tcg-rpgce; 4 for rpg-pet; 26 / 49 / 57 for rpg-edit-hq / rpg-dust / rpg-space

preconditions.title: Every game already has pages (rooms) in rooms.pdl: 66 pages over 11 games
preconditions.evidence: RAN today: ROOM rows per game 7 6 6 6 6 6 7 6 3 7 6

preconditions.title: book_check can judge any game: all 11 report conformant=no, and the 5 games I itemised fail only the known 'source=board' item (A2)
preconditions.evidence: RAN today on all 11 (conformant=no for each); the failing item was listed for 5 of 11 (cdda-hq, rpg-edit-hq, rpg-space, tcg-rpgce, rpg-pet) and is A2 in each; the other 6 were not itemised

preconditions.title: Games are BOOK:PAGE capable: page file, game_page_export (with other characters as rows), page_follow, taskbar Synch for game boards
preconditions.evidence: RAN this week in scratch houses: harnesses game_page_export 147/0, page_follow 44/0, pc_synch_games 22/0; commits 336385812, b79f820aa, 1b0086ff7. The live taskbar was not pressed

preconditions.title: One game (rpg-space) is installed as a book on the owner's desk
preconditions.evidence: READ today: desk sessions = rpg-space, s1..s7 (8 books); 1 of 11 games

tasks.title: book_list op: scan @.apps for games (toy.pdl + *-pchq + rooms.pdl), write BOOK rows: id, app, pchq, pages, conformant, on_desk
tasks.proof: harness: scratch houses with 0, 1, 11 games; live repo gives exactly 11 rows; 6+ mutations fail it

tasks.title: page_list for a book: pages from the game's rooms.pdl, cross-checked with its maps/<g>/game.pdl desk ids (book_check B2 logic)
tasks.proof: harness: 11 live games give 66 pages total; a game whose rooms and desks disagree is reported

tasks.title: Core publishes the lists to ui.txt (n_book, book_N_label/act, target page list) and gets verbs openbook <id> / openpage <book> <room> that only record state/edit_target.txt
tasks.proof: all 11 games rebuild; per-game verb-script diff gate shows no behaviour change when the toolbar data does not ask for the list; new cases for the lists

tasks.title: Editor template: Book dropdown repeats the books, Page dropdown shows the chosen book's pages (rpg-edit-hq's own xhtpm and toolbar.pdl only)
tasks.proof: ui.txt says n_book=11; picture of the open Book dropdown with 11 rows (needs a live window)

tasks.title: openbook <id>: start the target game's own daemon and board window (its tabs and sidebars come with it), mark it edit mode, hand over from the editor window
tasks.proof: relay-driven: pick cdda-hq, its window appears with its 10 tabs and 3 bars; state file shows edit_target; no stray processes after close; footprint line idle + active

tasks.title: openpage <book> <room>: goto in the target via its existing goto verb
tasks.proof: state file room changes in the target; picture of that room

tasks.title: Edit affordances in the loaded game: confirm place / remove / newroom / newpal work from the target's own window; add an edit-mode strip only if they do not
tasks.proof: place a block from the window; ledger row + state file; remove it again; bytes restored
tasks.touches: target templates or a shared strip

tasks.title: Install the other games as desk books, one at a time (additive; backup before, restore rule after), so the desk Book dropdown and Synch see them
tasks.proof: sessions tree: files added only, 0 existing changed, sha256 list kept under the home folder (not /tmp); desk dropdown picture

tasks.title: Round trip: open a book, save unchanged, bytes identical (S4 of the pivot); then one real edit with a ledger row
tasks.proof: sha256 before == after for the unchanged save; one edit shows in the page file and the ledger

tasks.title: Picture pack: for each of the 11 games, Book dropdown, Page dropdown, loaded game with tabs and bars (the house's evidence rule)
tasks.proof: 11 x 3 pictures with receipts, taken one process at a time, niced, machine cool

tasks.title: Recipe + README + harness rows: how a new game appears in the list; update GAMES-AS-BOOKS doc and the roadmap
tasks.proof: doc exists, a fresh reader can add a 12th game from it (test: a scratch game appears in book_list)

tasks.title: Make PET_APP a runtime value (24 uses in 23 lines of the core) so one binary can serve any game folder
tasks.proof: all 11 games rebuild with identical behaviour (diff gate); editor binary answers for another folder

tasks.title: Per-game rule code (240 to 1,823 lines each) cannot live in one binary: forward verbs to the target's own binary
tasks.proof: a verb typed in the editor changes the target's state files exactly as the target's own window would

tasks.title: Mirror the target's ui.txt into the editor's, and satisfy the daemon's 'window alive' gate
tasks.proof: editor window shows the target's live variables
tasks.risk: high: the gate was only read in a harness comment

tasks.title: Swap the editor's template, css, toolbar.pdl and side_style.pdl to the target's at runtime (live reparse)
tasks.proof: picture: the editor window shows cdda's tabs and bars, then rpg-space's different 14 tabs

tasks.title: Headless daemon mode (no window needed) so a target can run without its own window
tasks.proof: daemon ticks and publishes with no window process; idle cost measured

spikes.question: Is opening a second game window while another is open safe on this machine (CPU, heat, freeze)? Do it once, niced, watching temperature, only when the machine is cool and idle.
spikes.why: the 15:21 freeze happened ~30 s after a board launch; cause unproven

spikes.question: Does a game's own window already expose enough editing (place from the hotbar, new room, new pal), or does edit mode need its own strip?
spikes.why: verbs exist in all 11 binaries; whether the window reaches them was not tested for 10 of 11

spikes.question: What exactly gates ui.txt publishing (a process whose command line holds <game>.xhtpm was read in a harness comment, not in the code path)?
Can one window be re-pointed to another game by rewriting its template and letting the live reparse pick it up (with the other game's variables)?
What does closing the editor do to the target's daemon and engine (stray processes)? Memory: button.sh leaks engine stacks
spikes.why: a footprint finding would be ours, not the browser's

decisions.question: Road A first (the editor launches the target's own window with its tabs and bars) and keep Road B for later?
decisions.note: A recommended; B only if you need one single window to turn into any game

decisions.question: Does the Book dropdown list all 11 games, or only conformant ones?
decisions.note: All 11 fail book_check A2 today, so conformance cannot be the filter yet; recommend list all, show a conformant flag

decisions.question: After you pick a game: does the editor window stay as a small launcher bar, or does the target's window replace it?
Install the other 10 games as desk books too (A8), one at a time?
decisions.note: touches your desk data; additive with backup and restore rule

decisions.question: Is rpg-edit-hq's own 6-room town also a book in the list ('rpg-edit'), or only the editor shell?
decisions.note: it is a pets-like game today

sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.exit: ui.txt of the editor lists 11 books and any book's pages; all 11 games rebuild with no behaviour change; harnesses green; NO live launch needed

sprints.name: Sprint 2
sprints.exit: relay-driven: two different games opened from the dropdown with their own tabs and bars, pictures + state files + footprint line; one process at a time

sprints.name: Sprint 3
sprints.exit: one real edit round-trips with a ledger row; one more game installed as a desk book with the restore rule honoured

sprints.name: Sprint 4
sprints.exit: 11 x 3 pictures with receipts; the feature is declared done only now
